Theorem
[Bernstein theorem for mean-curvature-type equations]1. ch16:16.12\group chapter-16↗ gilbarg-trudinger.cor.16.19.quasiconformal-gauss-map-bernstein Let $u\in C^2(\mathbb R^2)$ solve (16.63) on $\mathbb R^2$, with $b\equiv 0$, and assume (16.64). Then $u$ is affine.
Proof

\sketch By (16.89), the Gauss map of the graph is $(K,0)$-quasiconformal with $K=-\gamma $. Corollary 16.19 makes the normal constant, hence $Du$ is constant.

□
